name: connection-settings-help-phone
description: At a phone viewport the shared connection settings row stacks its label, control, and help in one column. PropertyList's settings variant puts the help inside .settingsValue under the control; without the mobile one-column reset of .settingsRow, the row keeps its 104px label track and the input and help sit beside the label instead of below it.

mutation.declaration: widgets/propertylist/propertylist.module.css: the @media (max-width: 480px) .settingsRow { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) } reset (removed from the media selector list), leaving the two-column settings grid at a phone width
mutation.note: Observed red run with .settingsRow removed from the phone media selector: the row measured 2 tracks (104px 242px), and the input and help both started 116px from the label's left edge, beside it. Restoring the reset passes: one 358px column, a 358px input, and the help below it.
